name: Outlier Filter
description: Drops rows whose numeric values fall outside a per-column outlier range: IQR fences (q1 - k*iqr, q3 + k*iqr) or z-score bounds (mean +- k*stddev). Multiple columns are combined with AND, missing values always pass, and the statistics come from the whole input table.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric columns whose outliers are filtered; a row must pass every listed column.

method.title: Method
method.description: iqr uses quartile fences, zscore uses the distance from the mean in standard deviations.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Multiplier for the fence width: the IQR multiplier (default 1.5) or the z-score limit (default 3).
